## Summary (≤150 words)

As of **2026-11-07**, seed exact model revisions and explicitly distinguish nominal, usable and AC-delivered battery energy. Product names do not reliably encode usable capacity. Compatibility also depends on module count and firmware: BYD’s current matrix permits different HVM minimums across inverter families. [BYD documents](https://site.bydbatterybox.com/downloads)

The tables below are a starter catalogue, not a market-share ranking. Numeric prices are observed public equipment offers or identified installed-cost references. They are not wholesale purchasing commitments. Unknown tax basis, availability or exact configuration is marked **UNVERIFIED**, rather than converted into invented net prices.

Germany-wide “2026 averages” are not established by a handful of web offers. The strongest retrieved consumer price index is a limited sample spanning January 2025–August 2026, explicitly unsuitable as a current quote benchmark. [Verbraucherzentrale](https://www.verbraucherzentrale-hessen.de/wissen/energie/erneuerbare-energien/was-kostet-eine-photovoltaikanlage-49155)

### German installed-cost references

These sources disagree materially; do not merge them into a purported national average.

| Item | Retrieved evidence | Appropriate use |
|---|---|---|
| **5 kWp PV** | Verbraucherzentrale 4–6 kWp sample mean €2,090/kWp; ADAC partner example roughly €10,300 total. | Size-class sample mean/vendor example; national range U. |
| **10 kWp PV** | VZ >9–10 mean €1,410/kWp. co2online March2026 range €9,200–10,400 installed → **€920–1,040/kWp**, derived. | Present source and scope; not interchangeable averages. |
| **15 kWp PV** | VZ >14–16 mean €1,220/kWp. co2online €15k–21k → **€1,000–1,400/kWp**, derived. | Orientation, quote completeness and scope matter. |
| **20 kWp PV** | VZ >16 mean €1,010/kWp. co2online €18k–26k → **€900–1,300/kWp**, derived. | Broad class/sample, not guaranteed quote. |
| **Battery with new PV** | VZ sample means by size: 4–6kWh €510/kWh; >6–8 €480; >8–10 €410; >10–12 €390; >12–16 €360. | Co-installation evidence; not retrofit-equipment prices. |
| **11 kW wallbox installed** | ADAC roughly **€1,200–3,500**, device plus installation; installation alone €500–3,000. | Consumer all-in orientation, not net equipment cost. |
| **Air-water HP before subsidy** | Stiebel vendor orientation **€24k–32k gross installed**; device €12k–15.9k. | One vendor’s reference, not German market average. |
| **Scaffolding** | Installer reference roughly **€500–1,400**; scope/tax basis uncertain. | Provisional service allowance only. |
| **Meter cabinet** | Same installer reference: retrofit €1,500–3,000; full exchange €1,800–3,500. | Site-specific, tax basis uncertain. |
| **Grid registration** | No defensible universal PV service-fee range verified. ADAC says wallbox notification itself is free. | Distinguish network fee from electrician’s administrative service. |

Sources: [VZ PV](https://www.verbraucherzentrale-hessen.de/wissen/energie/erneuerbare-energien/was-kostet-eine-photovoltaikanlage-49155), [VZ batteries](https://www.verbraucherzentrale-brandenburg.de/wissen/energie/erneuerbare-energien/was-kostet-eine-photovoltaikanlage-49155), [co2online](https://www.co2online.de/modernisieren-und-bauen/photovoltaik/kosten-und-finanzierung/), [ADAC PV](https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-haus/energie/versorgung/solaranlage-mit-speicher/), [ADAC wallbox](https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/elektromobilitaet/laden/wallbox-kosten/), [Stiebel](https://www.stiebel-eltron.de/de/waermepumpen-ratgeber/kosten-foerderung/waermepumpe-kosten.html), [service allowances](https://schoenwaldhandwerkerservice.de/photovoltaik-was-ist-enthalten.html).

## Implications for our product

**Compatibility follow-up:** see [COMPATIBILITY.md](COMPATIBILITY.md) for reopened manufacturer matrices, conditional pairings and pitch wording. Full catalogue/site compatibility and application enforcement remain UNVERIFIED.

- Store model revision, region, source date and availability.
- Keep battery nominal/usable/AC energy separate.
- Validate inverter–battery pairing, firmware and module count.
- Include controllers, meters, activation licences, bases and backup equipment in BOM.
- Keep retail equipment, installer purchase and turnkey prices separate.
- Keep tax basis and package inclusions explicit.
- Disable recommendation eligibility for unresolved compatibility/capacity entries.
- Use source-specific price scenarios, not a fabricated 2026 average.

## Open questions / uncertainty

- Current wholesale installer net prices remain largely unavailable publicly.
- Several advertised prices concern unavailable or older revisions.
- SAJ usable capacity, some whole-system stack limits and Tesla package pricing remain U.
- Meyer Burger supply/warranty continuity and Lynus identity require verification.
- JSON `null` prices below mean **UNVERIFIED**, not free.
- Entries with unresolved usable capacity or compatibility are draft catalogue records, not activated sizing options.
